headline: 3 Bangladeshi family members killed in stabbing attack in Italy
summary: A father, mother, and their 6-year-old daughter were killed in their Rome apartment. Their 18-year-old son survived the attack.
details: Three members of a Bangladeshi family were killed in a stabbing attack at their residential flat in Rome, Italy, on Friday night, June 26.
The victims include 39-year-old Kamal Uddin, his wife Arzu (38), and their 6-year-old daughter Alicia. The family had been living in Italy for a long time.
The couple's 18-year-old son, Aniyan, was injured during the attack but survived. He was rushed to a local hospital in critical condition, though doctors have since stated he is now out of danger.
The attack took place at a flat on Via Montilio road near Pineta Sacchetti in western Rome, according to the state news agency ANSA and local media.
Police are currently conducting an operation to arrest the killer. Investigators believe the attacker may have been known to the family, as there were no signs of forced entry into the home.
The victims' ancestral home is in Basurhat, Noakhali, Bangladesh.
caption:
A father, mother, and 6-year-old daughter killed in Rome; only the 18-year-old son survives.

Three members of a Bangladeshi family were killed in a stabbing attack at their residential flat in Rome, Italy, on Friday night, June 26.

The victims include 39-year-old Kamal Uddin, his wife Arzu (38), and their 6-year-old daughter Alicia. The family had been living in Italy for a long time.

The couple's 18-year-old son, Aniyan, was injured during the attack but survived. He was rushed to a local hospital in critical condition, though doctors have since stated he is now out of danger.

The attack took place at a flat on Via Montilio road near Pineta Sacchetti in western Rome, according to the state news agency ANSA and local media.

Police are currently conducting an operation to arrest the killer. Investigators believe the attacker may have been known to the family, as there were no signs of forced entry into the home.

The victims' ancestral home is in Basurhat, Noakhali, Bangladesh.

headline_marked: 9-hour [[power outage scheduled for several areas]] in Bangladesh
headline: 9-hour power outage scheduled for several areas in Bangladesh
summary: Certain regions will face extended electricity cuts today, causing significant disruption to daily activities.
details: Several areas across the country will experience continuous power outages for up to 9 hours starting from this morning.
The outages are scheduled for maintenance or technical reasons, affecting multiple districts and local neighborhoods.
Residents in the affected areas are advised to plan their daily activities and backup power sources accordingly to minimize inconvenience.
The authorities have issued the notice to ensure the stability of the power grid and prevent further unplanned outages.
